newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR SEES 1997 EARNINGS UP TO MATCH 1995.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR SEES 1997 EARNINGS UP TO MATCH 1995.

text.p: Finnish sweetener, feeds and bakery group Cultor Oy said on Thursday it expected group 1997 earnings to improve after a fall last year and come close to the performance of 1995.
"We expect the result to improve this year and to be close to that achieved in 1995," Cultor said in a statement with its 1996 results.

Cultor in 1995 reported a 494 million markka profit after financial items with operating profit 528 million markka and earnings per share 14.91 markka. Its 1996 profit after financial items fell 21 percent to 391 million markka.
"Cultor's divisions and units are well-placed for 1997 in terms of their market position," the company said.

"The impact of the group's investments, structural changes, and rationalisation implemented in recent years is expected to make a positive contribution to the 1997 result," it said, adding that its earnings tend to strengthen in the second half of the year.
